fixed_effect: Validation confidence target-minus-rest >=5pp AND adjusted association gap >0
denominator: ALL selected slots, not Discovery signal subset; nonestimable slots count as not retained
quartiles: pandas linear quantiles across estimable selected group-rule slots; missing excluded and reported
duplicates: Original allocation retained; same direction in different groups is a separate group-rule slot, not an independent statistical replicate
random: One complete three-group system per seed; compare system median/gap/retention with real L; no pooling seed-rule observations
G: No target/rest contrast for global scope; G not assigned artificial zero
flow: These are target-group rule evidence measures, not coverage; identical under restricted/shared selection
limitations: Posthoc descriptive analysis, not confirmatory significance
No new BY/BH or customer-bootstrap intervals; quartiles describe rule heterogeneity, not uncertainty
No added Validation count gate; low counts can yield unstable differences
Unchanged Test; no remine or rerank
